# SEVEN3SEVEN

> Hybrid fitness and performance brand producing structured strength, endurance and conditioning programmes built to be followed, not filed away.

SEVEN3SEVEN (also known as 737 TRG) is founded by Nico, a former British Army soldier and All Arms Physical Training Instructor. Programmes combine an interactive app experience with a permanent downloadable PDF.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview and current programmes.
- [About](/about): The story behind SEVEN3SEVEN and its founder.
- [Programmes](/programmes): Full catalogue of hybrid training programmes.
- [Basic Training Blueprint+](/programmes/basic-training-blueprint-plus): 12-week Army assessment and Basic Training preparation programme.
- [S.E.M 2026](/programmes/sem-2026): 8-week hybrid competition programme for ATHX-style athletes.
- [Hybrid Race Plan](/programmes/hybrid-race-plan): 12-week hybrid race programme for HYROX-style and Hybrid Games-style events.
- [Apparel](/apparel): SEVEN3SEVEN apparel.
